day_09_morning: ^The ninth morning comes without a Bell. That is how you know it is the last one.
^Aurel is quiet below you. Not the Quiet. Just quiet.
^Mara is checking her hammer. Iven is checking the exits. Wren is checking the sky.
^Toma has filled three pages already. He stops when you look at him.
^Whatever happens today, Toma says, I am writing it down.
^Wren does not look away from the sky. There is one thing we have not tried, she says.
^Rest with the party. Save your strength.
hidden: ^My mother kept a second bell, Wren says. Small enough to hold. It remembers the city before the loop.
^She taps her chest. Here, she says. It has been here the whole time.
rally: ^You go down to the city one last time. You tell them what is coming.
^Some of them believe you. Some of them are already forgetting. It does not matter.
^Mara stands beside you the whole way.
rest: ^You sit on the stair and eat cold bread. Iven complains about the bread. Mara laughs at him.
^For a few minutes, no one is a Bellkeeper or a rebel or a debt.
^Then the sky goes dark, and the ninth day begins in earnest.
day_09_afternoon: ^The Quiet is waiting at the Bell. It is not a monster. It is a woman with a Bellkeeper's hands.
^The first Bellkeeper, Wren says. My mother.
^She looks at you with eyes that have seen eight versions of this conversation.
^You came back, she says. They always come back.
^You are the one who rang it wrong, Mara says.
^I am the one who rang it at all.
name: ^bg:quiet
^Her name is Orra Vane. Wren's mother. Sera's aunt. The first Bellkeeper.
^id:d9a_007
^speaker:Narration
^The Quiet flinches. For a moment, she is only a woman.
^id:d9a_008
^speaker:Narration
^Then the Bell rings, and the moment is gone.

strike: ^Mara moves first. The Quiet turns toward her, and the room fills with a sound like snow.
^You follow. There is no more time for names.
ask: ^I wanted one more day, the Quiet says. That is all. One more day with him.
^You have had eight, Iven says. That is not a day. That is a habit.
day_09_night: ^The Quiet falls. The Bell is open. The ninth day is yours to end.
^Mara is on your left. Iven is on your right. Wren is holding the small bell.
^Toma writes the date. Then he closes the book, because some things do not need a page.
end_ring: ^You put your hand on the crown. The Bell is warm. It has been waiting to be touched.
^Tomorrow, you tell them, we ring it together.
^The Bell rings. The city remembers how to begin again.
end_break: ^You put your hand on the crack. It fits the shape of your palm.
^If we break it, Mara says, some of us will not remember the way back.
end_become: ^You put your hand inside the Bell. The dark is full of every version of the city.
^Wren stops counting. Whatever you are about to do, she says, do it as yourself.
^You become the thing that holds Aurel together.
